schemes.description: The Stand Up India Scheme was launched by the Government of India to promote entrepreneurship among women and scheduled castes and scheduled tribes. The scheme provides loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore to women entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises in the manufacturing, services, or trading sectors. The scheme also provides training and mentorship to the entrepreneurs. The Stand Up India Scheme was launched in 2016 and is being implemented by the Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI). The scheme has a provision for a subsidy of 25% of the loan amount, which is given to the entrepreneurs after they have made timely repayments for a certain period. The scheme also has a provision for a guarantee fee, which is 0.25% of the loan amount per annum.
eligibility: The applicant should be a woman entrepreneur.
The applicant should be between 18 and 45 years old.
The applicant should have a good credit score.
